# `make_time`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
make_time(hour, minute, second)
```

Create time from hour, minute and second fields. For invalid inputs it will throw an error.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | 3 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- make_time, example 1
> SELECT make_time(6, 30, 45.887);
06:30:45.887
```

```sql
-- make_time, example 2
> SELECT make_time(NULL, 30, 0);
NULL
```
